g.text: LUAD - normal | all 21 declared, eligible broad-receiver tests in this contrast
Up triangles: up; down triangles: down. Filled: global q < 0.05; open: tested without meeting that threshold.
Size = -log10(q), capped at 4; x = pathway not assigned to this receiver in the declared test family.
Across all 279 primary-family tests: estimated correlation 0/279; fixed 0.01 sensitivity 148/279.
Both columns use the existing patient-blocked CAMERA analysis; competitive direction and q values are not GSEA NES or effect sizes.
